text: A repeating secret word of 29 letters on two tables built from puzzle words (here LUCID for the message and WONDERFUL for the copper). The known letters fix 24 slots; the climb tries every letter in the other 5.
The best text at each period sits with what the same climb finds on a shuffled copper, far from English at about -3.6.
All 3,721 table pairs at periods 27 to 29, 33,489 climbs: the readings that pass every gate do so by construction and read as noise. Periodic keys at these lengths are closed for vocabulary tables.
